title: OpenJoystickDriver endpoint access grants
description: The file AccessGrants.json in the OpenJoystickDriver Application Support folder. Only the service writes it, when 'ojd access enable', 'disable', 'grant', or 'revoke' runs.

scope.description: 'read' receives controller events; 'control' drives a virtual gamepad.

grant.description: A client the user allowed, matched by its code signature.

kind.description: 'team' matches the identifier signed by an Apple-issued certificate of the team; 'apple' matches the identifier signed by Apple.

teamIdentifier.description: The signing team; present for 'team' grants.

grantedAt.description: When the latest 'ojd access grant' for this client ran.

path.description: Where the client was when it was granted; for display only.
